_doc: V2 deterministic oil_type + grade classifier. Derive oil_type and grade from the PRODUCT NAME only - NEVER from the search query/category field. A competitor row matches a JIVO anchor ONLY if its name-derived oil_type EQUALS the anchor's oil_type. Sesame/mustard/sunflower/groundnut can NEVER match canola; canola never matches anything else.
_bug_fixed: 'Patanjali Virgin Sesame Oil (Gingelly/Til Oil)' was wrongly shown under Canola because it returned from the 'canola oil' search. Oil type is now name-derived: it classifies as sesame.
_consumer_logic: 1. Lowercase the product NAME (ignore the search-query 'category' field entirely).
2. BLEND GATE FIRST (exclusion): if any oil_type.blend keyword is present in the name, oil_type='blend' -> exclude this row from every single-oil anchor, regardless of any other oil word present.
3. Otherwise assign oil_type = the FIRST entry in 'priority' whose keyword list matches the name (single oils tested before blend; more-specific first).

4. Grade = the FIRST entry in 'grade_priority' whose keyword list matches the name; grade is only enforced for olive (extra_virgin|extra_light|pomace) and mustard (kachi_ghani/cold_pressed vs refined) anchors.

5. A row joins an anchor only if oil_type == anchor.oil_type AND (anchor has no grade OR grade matches the anchor grade) AND pack volume within ~15% (density 0.916 for oil: 910 g -> ~993 ml still matches a 1 L anchor).
6. If an anchor has no like-for-like rival after these gates, report 'no direct competitor' - NEVER force a wrong oil (canola usually has none on Indian q-comm; cold-pressed sunflower is rare).
_regional_words: Enne=oil(Kannada); Sasive=mustard; Suryakanthi/Surajmukhi=sunflower; Kadale=groundnut; Gingelly/Til/Ellu=sesame; Akki=rice bran; Nariyal/Copra=coconut; Jaitun=olive; 'Kachi Ghani'=cold-pressed mustard.
